title: t4rch
description: a plugin i made inspired by wifies video Solving the m4tchbox mystery to list all commands in game do /helpt4rch
body: This is a mod inspired by wifies video "Solving The M4tchbox mystery".In this mod there is a medic a spark and a innocent and innocents job is to find out who the spark is and not die. The sparks job is to mark someone with an empty hand for them to die and they can swap places with someone by clicking f. The medics job is to right click on someone with a empty hand to protect them (if that person is marked by the spark that person does not die) Game mechanics: everyones nametag is hidden until you shoot at them with a crossbow then their nametag is shown. Secondly, players can not speak in chat unless it is discussion time or voting time lastly if you die and there still is a chance that the innocents and medic can win you get to go in spectator mode and spectate the match. for help in game do /helpt4rch
